# typescriptc

> A whole-program TypeScript-to-C transpiler. Takes TS source + its local imports (and resolvable `node_modules` package sources), emits C11, links with gcc and Boehm GC, produces a native Linux binary that behaves like `node file.ts` for the supported subset.

Current status: **661 passing e2e tests**, ~31,900 LOC (compiler ~20,700, runtime ~10,150, type shim ~1,330). The supported subset covers the typed TS core including String.raw tagged templates, classes (incl. generic classes, static init blocks, computed members), interfaces (incl. `extends`), first-class typed closures over function-scope captures, NaN-boxed dynamic values for `any`/`unknown` with full operator/method/Object/Reflect/descriptor/accessor coverage, eager `function*` generators with `yield*`/`return(value)`/`throw(error)`, custom iterables and self-iterable iterator objects, settled+immediate Promise with `new Promise(executor)`, `Promise.try`, callback-returned native Promise adoption, `finally` returned-Promise state adoption, plus `async`/`await` (immediate, no suspend/resume), bounded before-exit `queueMicrotask`, bounded zero-delay `setTimeout` with `0`/`-0`/`undefined`/`void 0` delays and cancellable numeric handles plus undefined no-op clears, and bounded before-exit `setImmediate` with cancellable numeric handles plus undefined no-op clears, every Error constructor including `AggregateError`, `Map`/`Set`/`WeakMap`/`WeakSet`/`WeakRef`/`FinalizationRegistry` plus ES2024 `Map.groupBy`/`Object.groupBy` and ES2025 Set composition, PCRE2 RegExp with `RegExp.escape` and full replacement tokens, full sync Node stdlib (fs incl. explicit readFile Buffer/null options for sync/promises, readdir/realpath/readlink/mkdtemp Buffer options, bounded Buffer/file URL path arguments, cp/stat/symlink/utimes/chown/chmod/access/mkdir/recursive/Dirent/encoding/read/write/append flag/mode options, path, Math, os incl. devNull/userInfo, Date UTC/local constructor/getter/setter subset, Number, Buffer, URL incl. canParse/base resolution), synchronous `EventEmitter`, synchronous `Event`/`EventTarget` with literal listener options, immediate `fs.promises` mirror, immediate `dns.lookup`/`dns.promises.lookup`, `net.isIP`, sync + immediate-callback `child_process.exec`/`execFile`/`execSync`/`execFileSync`/`spawnSync` with full literal options (encoding/cwd/env/shell/argv0/detached/maxBuffer/timeout/killSignal/uid/gid/stdio/POSIX-inert windows*), `process.*` metadata (env/argv/argv0/title/versions/release/features/pid/ppid/hrtime/hrtime.bigint/cpuUsage/resourceUsage/memoryUsage/getgroups/umask/uid/gid/euid/egid/kill/stdout.write/stderr.write/nextTick with up to three args) plus bounded before-exit `queueMicrotask`, zero-delay `setTimeout`, `clearTimeout`, `setImmediate`, and `clearImmediate`, `node_modules` package source transpilation for TypeScript packages and basic JS packages with `allowJs`, plus a narrow CommonJS package-source subset covering top-level `exports.x`/`module.exports.x`/static `exports` aliases, `Object.defineProperty(exports, "default", { value })` default interop/`Object.defineProperty(exports, "x", { value })` data exports, static descriptor-variable `Object.defineProperty(exports, "x", descriptor)` exports/`Object.defineProperties(exports, { x: descriptor })` descriptor-map exports, static declared descriptor-map `Object.defineProperties(exports, descriptors)` exports, `Object.defineProperties(exports, Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(api))` descriptor-preserving exports/`module.exports = Object.defineProperties(...)` with static target object and wrapper-target metadata, `module.exports = Object.defineProperty(...)` including static target object and wrapper-target metadata, and static `Object.freeze`/`Object.seal`/`Object.preventExtensions`/`Object.setPrototypeOf` wrapper named metadata/`Object.assign(exports, { x })` data/default mutation, `Object.assign(exports, { get x() { return value; } })` getter mutation, static declared-object and static object-spread `Object.assign(exports, api)` mutation/`Object.assign(exports, require("./local.js"))` re-export mutation and `Object.assign(exports, { x: require("./local.js").x })` member re-export mutation, chained `exports.x = module.exports.x = value` aliases, whole-value `module.exports = exports.default = fn` function chains, `exports.x = void 0` / `module.exports.x = void 0` placeholder elision, and simple zero-arg getter exports/`module.exports = ...` defaults (incl. object/function/arrow/method/array/primitive/computed-string incl. static concatenation/template keys/`Object.assign`/`Object.create`/`Object.defineProperty`/`Object.defineProperties`/`Object.fromEntries`/`Object.setPrototypeOf`/`Object.preventExtensions`/`Object.seal`/`Object.freeze`/object-spread), top-level and function-scope literal `require(...)` namespace/destructure/direct-default/member calls and reads plus function-scoped `require` / `module.require` aliases, package-local `require("./local.js")`, top-level static `require` / `module.require` aliases, function-scoped `require` / `module.require` aliases, `module.require(...)`, side-effect requires, `__esModule` marker elision including `exports.__esModule = true`, `__filename`/`__dirname`/`module.filename|id|path|loaded|paths|parent|children|isPreloading`. Hard-error diagnostics for the three permanent AOT limits (native `.node` addons including transitively from package sources, `eval`/`Function`, non-literal `require(variable)`).

Phases not yet implemented: Phase 3 remainder (hidden classes / inline caches), Phase 6 remainder (real suspend/resume `await`, Promise microtask scheduling, nonzero/libuv timer/event-loop scheduling), Phase 7 remainder (lazy generator suspend/resume, async generators), Phase 9 (`Proxy`), Phase 11–13 remainder (libuv-backed async I/O, full `stream`, `http`/`https`/`http2`, `net` sockets, async `child_process` handles, `worker_threads`), Phase 14 remainder (lazy `require` timing, broader CommonJS wrapper, dual CJS/ESM interop). See [docs/todo.md](docs/todo.md) for the full remaining list with effort estimates.

## Architecture one-liner

```
entry.ts
  ↓  ts.createProgram (official TypeScript compiler API)
  ↓  src/resolve.ts — walks imports + CommonJS requires, topo-sorts modules
  ↓  src/emit/index.ts — 5-pass emitter producing one main.c
  ↓  src/link/cc.ts — gcc -O2 -std=c11 main.c runtime/tsc_runtime.c -lgc -lm -lpcre2-8 -lssl -lcrypto -licuuc -licui18n -lgmp, or -Os -s with --release
binary
```

## Hard limits (permanent)

Three JS features cannot be AOT-compiled at any engineering investment:

1. Native C++ addons under `node_modules/*/build/Release/*.node` — literal `.node` specifiers and resolved package roots containing `build/Release/*.node` are rejected, including transitively from emitted package sources.
2. Runtime code compilation (`eval`, `Function`, `new Function`) — rejected before TypeScript diagnostics.
3. Dynamic `require(variable)` with a non-literal specifier — rejected before emission.

Documented in [docs/todo.md](docs/todo.md#5-permanent-limits-will-never-be-done).

## Key files for code contributors

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/emit/index.ts` | the emitter — one class, ~19,000 LOC |
| `src/emit/types.ts` | TS → C type mapping |
| `src/resolve.ts` | module graph walker (TS imports + CommonJS requires) |
| `src/compile.ts` | pipeline orchestrator |
| `runtime/tsc_runtime.c` | runtime implementation (~9,300 LOC) |
| `runtime/tsc_runtime.h` | authoritative list of runtime capabilities |
| `stdlib/lib.core.d.ts` | TS declarations we accept |
| `tests/e2e/run.ts` | test harness |
| `tests/e2e/cases/` | 652 case dirs |
